summary: Get or create the Session for a partition.

semantics.normal: same partition returns same Session identity
semantics.edge: persist: partitions are persistent; empty partition returns defaultSession

caveats: Options only apply when the partition Session is first created; existing Session options cannot be changed.

tests.expected_behavior: same partition returns same Session identity
